name: media-band
description: Centred band: eyebrow, heading, a bold sub line, copy and a button over an optional wide image or a YouTube video (poster that plays in place on click). Used on the form pages (/get-a-quote-pro/, /start-a-free-trial-email-only/) for live's 'Manage your assets your way' video, 'Build with Ursa AI' banner and the closing trial call to action.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

layout.description: stack: copy centred over the media. split: copy left (7/12), media right (5/12) from 992px, as live's Build with Ursa AI band.

tone.description: soft: a rounded off-white panel (live's rounded off-white sections). white: no panel.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

body.description: Paragraph. Line breaks are kept; UrsaAI is set with its superscript.

cta_label.description: Button text. Renders only with cta_url.

cta_url.description: Button destination (a page, or #anchor of a form on the page).

image.description: Wide image under the copy; with video it is the poster.

image_width.description: Image intrinsic width in px. 0 omits it.

image_height.description: Image intrinsic height in px. 0 omits it.

video.description: YouTube URL (watch, youtu.be or embed form). The poster becomes a play button that swaps in the player; without JavaScript it opens the video on YouTube.

video_title.description: Accessible name of the video, e.g. Asset Panda overview video.

video_look.description: How a video sits under the copy. card: the poster in a rounded card with a soft shadow. theater: the kit's video theater (page-videos on /tutorials/): a dark indigo panel with brand glows around a 16:9 player, the poster cropped to fill it and a round white play button. Still plays only when clicked (no autoplay). No effect without a video.
